<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&family=DM+Serif+Display&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --bg: #F7F6F3;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --border: #E2E0DA;
    --border-focus: #1A1A1A;
    --text: #1A1A1A;
    --text-muted: #888880;
    --accent: #1A1A1A;
    --tag-bg: #EEECEA;
    --danger: #C0392B;
    --success: #27AE60;
    --radius: 10px;
  }

  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 0 20px 40px;
  }

  /* Menu de abas */
  .tab-nav {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 0 auto 32px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
    padding-top: 28px;
  }
  .tab-btn {
    height: 44px;
    padding: 0 24px;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    margin-bottom: -2px;
    background: transparent;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
  }
  .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .tab-btn.active {
    color: var(--text);
    border-bottom-color: var(--text);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .tab-pane { display: none; }
  .tab-pane.active { display: block; }

  /* Campos do contrato */
  .contrato-section {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 28px 32px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .contrato-section-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 1.2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .contrato-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .contrato-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .contrato-field label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .contrato-field input, .contrato-field select, .contrato-field textarea {
    padding: 0 14px;
    height: 42px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text);
    background: var(--bg);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  }
  .contrato-field textarea {
    height: auto;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    resize: vertical;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .contrato-field input:focus, .contrato-field select:focus, .contrato-field textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--border-focus);
    background: #fff;
  }
  .col-full { grid-column: span 2; }

  @media (max-width: 580px) {
    .contrato-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .col-full { grid-column: span 1; }
    .tab-btn { padding: 0 14px; font-size: 13px; }
  }

  .header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    padding-top: 4px;
  }
  .header img {
    height: 56px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .header h1 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  }
  .header p {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .container {
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .card {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 28px 32px;
  }

  .card-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 1.2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .col-span-2 { grid-column: span 2; }

  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .field label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .field input, .field select {
    height: 42px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--text);
    background: var(--bg);
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    outline: none;
  }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus {
    border-color: var(--border-focus);
    background: #fff;
  }
  .field input::placeholder { color: #BBBBB5; }

  /* Serviços toggles */
  .servicos-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .servico-toggle {
    position: relative;
  }
  .servico-toggle input[type="checkbox"] {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    width: 0; height: 0;
  }
  .servico-toggle label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .servico-toggle label .check-icon {
    width: 18px; height: 18px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .servico-toggle input:checked + label {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: #F5F4F1;
  }
  .servico-toggle input:checked + label .check-icon {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent);
    color: white;
  }

  /* Painel de valores */
  .valores-panel {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .valores-panel.visible { display: flex; }

  .valor-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .valor-row-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .valor-row-label small {
    display: block;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }
  .valor-row input {
    width: 140px;
    height: 38px;
    padding: 0 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-align: right;
    background: var(--bg);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.15s;
  }
  .valor-row input:focus {
    border-color: var(--border-focus);
    background: #fff;
  }

  /* Desconto toggle */
  .desconto-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    background: var(--tag-bg);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .desconto-row input[type="checkbox"] { width: 16px; height: 16px; cursor: pointer; accent-color: var(--accent); }
  .desconto-row label { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; }
  .desconto-row .desconto-val {
    margin-left: auto;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  .desconto-row .desconto-val input {
    width: 64px; height: 32px;
    padding: 0 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    text-align: center;
    background: #fff; outline: none;
  }
  .desconto-row .desconto-val span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); }

  /* Preview resumo */
  .resumo {
    background: var(--tag-bg);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    font-size: 13px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .resumo-linha {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .resumo-linha.total {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 15px;
    padding-top: 8px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  .resumo-linha .label { color: var(--text-muted); }

  /* Botão */
  .btn-gerar {
    width: 100%;
    height: 52px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: white;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
  }
  .btn-gerar:hover { opacity: 0.88; }
  .btn-gerar:active { transform: scale(0.99); }
  .btn-gerar:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

  .spinner {
    width: 18px; height: 18px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    border-top-color: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: spin 0.7s linear infinite;
    display: none;
  }
  .btn-gerar.loading .spinner { display: block; }
  .btn-gerar.loading .btn-text { display: none; }

  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  .msg {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 10px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: none;
  }
  .msg.success { background: #EAFAF1; color: var(--success); display: block; }
  .msg.error { background: #FDEDEC; color: var(--danger); display: block; }

  /* Seletor empresa contrato */
  #lbl_gaideski.ativo, #lbl_planicom.ativo {
    border-color: #1A1A1A;
    background: #F5F4F0;
  }

  /* Tabela de honorários */
  .tabela-section { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 24px 28px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .tabela-section h3 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .tabela-hon { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
  .tabela-hon th { background: #F5F5F5; font-weight: 600; padding: 9px 12px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid #E0E0E0; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 12px; }
  .tabela-hon td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); vertical-align: middle; }
  .tabela-hon tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .tabela-hon tr:hover td { background: var(--tag-bg); }
  .tabela-hon td.val { text-align: right; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
  .tabela-hon td.faixa { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }
  .tabela-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .tabela-tag { padding: 5px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg); transition: all 0.15s; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .tabela-tag.active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
  .tabela-tag:hover:not(.active) { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
  .calc-box { background: var(--tag-bg); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .calc-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .calc-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .calc-field select, .calc-field input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; font-family: DM Sans,sans-serif; font-size: 14px; background: #fff; outline: none; }
  .calc-result { grid-column: span 2; text-align: center; padding: 14px; background: var(--surface); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .calc-result .valor { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }
  .calc-result .desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; }
  @media (max-width: 580px) { .calc-box { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .calc-result { grid-column: span 1; } }

  /* Autocomplete honorários */
  .ac-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; }
  .ac-list {
    position: absolute; top: 44px; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 999;
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E2E0DA; border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); max-height: 320px;
    overflow-y: auto; display: none; font-family: DM Sans,sans-serif;
  }
  .ac-list.open { display: block; }
  .ac-item {
    padding: 9px 14px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #F0EEE8; display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  .ac-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .ac-item:hover, .ac-item.selected { background: #F5F4F1; }
  .ac-item-nome { flex: 1; color: #1A1A1A; }
  .ac-item-valor { font-weight: 600; color: #1A1A1A; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 12px; }
  .ac-item-dept { font-size: 11px; color: #AAAAAA; margin-top: 1px; }

  /* Seletor de formato */
  .formato-selector {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .formato-btn {
    flex: 1;
    height: 44px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--bg);
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 7px;
  }
  .formato-btn.active {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
  }
  .formato-btn:not(.active):hover {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent);
  }

  /* Histórico */
  .hist-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 12px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.1s;
  }
  .hist-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .hist-item:hover { background: var(--tag-bg); margin: 0 -8px; padding: 12px 8px; border-radius: 8px; }
  .hist-num { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: var(--tag-bg); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-info { min-width: 0; }
  .hist-nome { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .hist-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }
  .hist-valor { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
  .hist-del { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .hist-del:hover { border-color: #C0392B; color: #C0392B; }
  .hist-empty { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; padding: 20px 0; }
  .hist-search { width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; font-family: DM Sans,sans-serif; font-size: 13px; background: var(--bg); outline: none; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .hist-search:focus { border-color: var(--border-focus); background: #fff; }

  @media (max-width: 580px) {
    .grid-2, .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .col-span-2 { grid-column: span 1; }
    .servicos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .card { padding: 20px; }
    .valor-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .valor-row input { width: 100%; }
    .hist-item { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; }
    .hist-valor { display: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- Menu de abas -->
<nav class="tab-nav">
  <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="trocarAba('orcamento')">
    📄 Orçamentos
  </button>
  <button class="tab-btn" onclick="trocarAba('contrato')">
    📝 Contratos
  </button>
  <button class="tab-btn" onclick="trocarAba('tabela')">
    💰 Honorários
  </button>
  <button class="tab-btn" onclick="trocarAba('dashboard')">
    📊 Dashboard
  </button>
</nav>

<div id="pane-orcamento" class="tab-pane active">
<div style="display:flex;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;">
  <button id="marcaBtn_gaideski" onclick="selecionarMarcaOrc('gaideski')"
    style="flex:1;padding:10px 16px;border:none;border-bottom:3px solid #1A1A1A;margin-bottom:-2px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transition:all 0.15s;">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAtgAAAH0CAYAAAAHVVrVAAABAGlDQ1BpY2MAABiVY2BgPMEABCwGDAy5eSVFQe5OChGRUQrsDxgYgRAMEpOLCxhwA6Cqb9cgai/r4lGHC3CmpBYnA+kPQKxSBLQcaKQIkC2SDmFrgNhJELYNiF1eUlACZAeA2EUhQc5AdgqQrZGOxE5C..." style="display:none;">
    🔵 Gaideski
  </button>
  <button id="marcaBtn_planicom" onclick="selecionarMarcaOrc('planicom')"
    style="flex:1;padding:10px 16px;border:none;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-2px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transition:all 0.15s;">
    🟢 Planicom
  </button>
</div>
<div class="header">
  <img id="orc_logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo" style="height:60px;object-fit:contain;">
  <h1 id="orc_titulo">Gerador de Orçamentos</h1>
  <p id="orc_subtitulo">Preencha os dados do cliente e gere o documento .docx automaticamente</p>
</div>

<div class="container">

  <!-- DADOS DO CLIENTE -->
  <div class="card">
    <div class="card-title">Dados do Cliente</div>
    <div class="grid-2">
      <div class="field col-span-2">
        <label>Nome do cliente / empresa</label>
        <input type="text" id="nomeCliente" placeholder="Ex: Daniel Silva" />
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Número do orçamento <span id="numAutoTag" style="font-size:10px;background:#EEECEA;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;margin-left:4px;letter-spacing:0.5px;">AUTO</span></label>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;">
          <input type="text" id="numOrcamento" style="flex:1;" placeholder="OR-001" readonly />
          <button onclick="editarNumero()" id="btnEditNum" title="Editar número" style="height:42px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all 0.15s;" onmouseover="this.style.borderColor='#1A1A1A'" onmouseout="this.style.borderColor='var(--border)'">✎ Editar</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Data da proposta</label>
        <input type="date" id="dataOrcamento" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SERVIÇOS -->
  <div class="card">
    <div class="card-title">Serviços incluídos</div>
    <div class="servicos-grid">

      <div class="servico-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="svcLucroReal" onchange="toggleServico()">
        <label for="svcLucroReal">
          <span class="check-icon">✓</span>
          Honorário — Lucro Real
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="servico-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="svcSimples" onchange="toggleServico()">
        <label for="svcSimples">
          <span class="check-icon">✓</span>
          Honorário — Simples Nacional
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="servico-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="svcAbertura" onchange="toggleServico()">
        <label for="svcAbertura">
          <span class="check-icon">✓</span>
          Abertura de Empresa
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="servico-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="svcCNPJ" onchange="toggleServico()">
        <label for="svcCNPJ">
          <span class="check-icon">✓</span>
          Compra de CNPJ
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="servico-toggle" style="grid-column:span 2;">
        <input type="checkbox" id="svcLivre" onchange="toggleServico()">
        <label for="svcLivre">
          <span class="check-icon">✓</span>
          + Serviço personalizado / avulso
        </label>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- VALORES DINÂMICOS -->
    <div class="valores-panel" id="valoresPanel">

      <div id="rowLucroReal" style="display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">
        <div class="valor-row">
          <div class="valor-row-label">
            Honorário Mensal — Lucro Real
            <small>Faturamento estimado (opcional)</small>
          </div>
          <input type="text" id="valLucroReal" value="R$ 2.813,00" oninput="atualizarResumo()" />
        </div>
        <div class="valor-row" style="align-items:flex-start; margin-top:2px;">
          <div class="valor-row-label" style="padding-top:8px;">Faturamento estimado</div>
          <input type="text" id="fatLucroReal" placeholder="Ex: R$ 130.000" style="width:140px; height:38px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif; font-size:13px; text-align:right; background:var(--bg); outline:none;" />
        </div>
        <div class="valor-row" style="align-items:flex-start;">
          <div class="valor-row-label" style="padding-top:8px;">Observação</div>
          <textarea id="obsLucroReal" placeholder="Ex: Pagamento até dia 10 de cada mês..." rows="2" style="flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);outline:none;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5;"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="rowSimples" style="display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
        <div class="valor-row">
          <div class="valor-row-label">Honorário Mensal — Simples Nacional</div>
          <input type="text" id="valSimples" value="R$ 810,00" oninput="atualizarResumo()" />
        </div>
        <div class="valor-row" style="align-items:flex-start;">
          <div class="valor-row-label" style="padding-top:8px;">Observação</div>
          <textarea id="obsSimples" placeholder="Observação opcional..." rows="2" style="flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);outline:none;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5;"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="rowAbertura" style="display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
        <div class="valor-row">
          <div class="valor-row-label">
            Abertura de Empresa
            <small>Informe o estado se necessário</small>
          </div>
          <input type="text" id="valAbertura" value="R$ 1.836,00" oninput="atualizarResumo()" />
        </div>
        <div class="valor-row" style="align-items:flex-start;">
          <div class="valor-row-label" style="padding-top:8px;">Observação</div>
          <textarea id="obsAbertura" placeholder="Ex: Abertura em SP, prazo estimado 15 dias..." rows="2" style="flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);outline:none;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5;"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="rowCNPJ" style="display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
        <div class="valor-row">
          <div class="valor-row-label">Compra de CNPJ</div>
          <input type="text" id="valCNPJ" value="R$ 3.500,00" oninput="atualizarResumo()" />
        </div>
        <div class="valor-row" style="align-items:flex-start;">
          <div class="valor-row-label" style="padding-top:8px;">Observação</div>
          <textarea id="obsCNPJ" placeholder="Observação opcional..." rows="2" style="flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);outline:none;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5;"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ITENS LIVRES -->
      <div id="rowLivre" style="display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;">
        <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--text-muted);padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">ITENS PERSONALIZADOS</div>
        <div id="itensLivreContainer" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;"></div>
        <button onclick="adicionarItemLivre()" id="btnAddItem" style="align-self:flex-start;height:36px;padding:0 16px;border:1.5px dashed #CCCCCA;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;color:#888880;transition:all 0.15s;">+ Adicionar item</button>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- HISTÓRICO -->
  <div class="card" id="cardHistorico" style="display:none;">
    <div class="card-title" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;">
      <span>Orçamentos Salvos</span>
      <button onclick="toggleHistorico()" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-muted);">✕ Fechar</button>
    </div>
    <input class="hist-search" type="text" id="histSearch" placeholder="🔍 Buscar por nome ou número..." oninput="renderHistorico()" />
    <div id="histLista"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- RESUMO -->
  <div class="card" id="cardResumo" style="display:none;">
    <div class="card-title">Resumo da Proposta</div>
    <div class="resumo" id="resumoContent"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- GERAR -->
  <div class="card">
    <div class="card-title">Gerar Documento</div>
    <div class="formato-selector">
      <button class="formato-btn active" id="fmtDocx" onclick="setFormato('orcamento','docx')">📄 Word (.docx)</button>
      <button class="formato-btn" id="fmtPdf" onclick="setFormato('orcamento','pdf')">📕 PDF</button>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-gerar" id="btnGerar" onclick="gerarDocumento()">
      <span class="btn-text" id="btnGerarLabel">⬇ Baixar Orçamento</span>
      <span class="spinner"></span>
    </button>
    <div class="msg" id="msg"></div>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;text-align:center;">
      <button onclick="toggleHistorico()" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;">

<!-- PAINEL CONTRATO -->
<div id="pane-contrato" class="tab-pane">

<div class="header">
  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Gaideski">
  <h1>Gerador de Contratos</h1>
  <p>Preencha os dados do cliente e gere o contrato em .docx automaticamente</p>
</div>

<div style="max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;">

  <!-- SELETOR DE EMPRESA -->
  <div class="contrato-section">
    <div class="contrato-section-title">Empresa Contratada (sua empresa)</div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;flex:1;min-width:200px;transition:all 0.15s;" id="lbl_gaideski" onclick="selecionarEmpresa('gaideski')">
        <input type="radio" name="empresa_contrato" id="radio_gaideski" value="gaideski" checked style="width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:#1A1A1A;cursor:pointer;" />
        <div>
          <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--text);">Gaideski Contabilidade</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">CNPJ 29.780.958/0001-24</div>
        </div>
      </label>
      <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;flex:1;min-width:200px;transition:all 0.15s;" id="lbl_planicom" onclick="selecionarEmpresa('planicom')">
        <input type="radio" name="empresa_contrato" id="radio_planicom" value="planicom" style="width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:#1A1A1A;cursor:pointer;" />
        <div>
          <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--text);">Planicom</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">CNPJ 59.517.312/0001-10</div>
        </div>
      </label>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- DADOS DA CONTRATANTE -->
  <div class="contrato-section">
    <div class="contrato-section-title">Dados da Contratante (Cliente)</div>
    <div class="contrato-grid">
      <div class="contrato-field col-full">
        <label>Razão Social / Nome da empresa *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_nome" placeholder="Ex: SILVA COMÉRCIO LTDA" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>CNPJ *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_cnpj" placeholder="00.000.000/0001-00" oninput="mascaraCNPJ(this)" maxlength="18" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Cargo do representante</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_cargo" placeholder="ADMINISTRADOR" value="ADMINISTRADOR" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field col-full">
        <label>Endereço completo da CONTRATANTE (cliente) *
          <span id="c_endereco_aviso" style="display:none;margin-left:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:#E85D24;background:#FEF3F0;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #E85D24;">
            ⚠️ Campo preenchido — verifique se está correto
          </span>
        </label>
        <input type="text" id="c_endereco" placeholder="RUA EXEMPLO, 123, BAIRRO, CIDADE - UF, CEP 00000-000" autocomplete="off"
          oninput="document.getElementById('c_endereco_aviso').style.display='none';"
          style="font-size:13px;" />
        <div id="c_endereco_preview" style="display:none;margin-top:4px;padding:6px 10px;background:#F5F5F3;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:#444;word-break:break-all;"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Nome do representante *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_rep" placeholder="FULANO DA SILVA" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>CPF do representante *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_cpf" placeholder="000.000.000-00" oninput="mascaraCPF(this)" maxlength="14" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PREÂMBULO -->
  <div class="contrato-section">
    <div class="contrato-section-title">Informações do Contrato</div>
    <div class="contrato-grid">
      <div class="contrato-field col-full">
        <label>Objeto / Ramo de atividade *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_objeto" placeholder="Ex: Comércio varejista de roupas." />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Folha de pagamento</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_folha" placeholder="Ex: Sem folha / 2 funcionários" value="Sem folha" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Vigência *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_vigencia" placeholder="Ex: 01 de abril de 2026" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Regime tributário *</label>
        <select id="c_regime">
          <option value="Simples Nacional">Simples Nacional</option>
          <option value="Lucro Real">Lucro Real</option>
          <option value="Lucro Presumido">Lucro Presumido</option>
          <option value="MEI">MEI</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Faturamento estimado</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_faturamento" placeholder="Ex: Até R$ 50.000,00/mês" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Remuneração (honorário) *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_remuneracao" placeholder="Ex: R$ 810,00 (oitocentos e dez reais)" />
      </div>
      <div class="contrato-field">
        <label>Vencimento (dia do mês) *</label>
        <input type="text" id="c_vencimento" placeholder="Ex: 05" value="05" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- GERAR -->
  <div class="contrato-section">
    <div class="contrato-section-title">Gerar Contrato</div>
    <div class="formato-selector">
      <button class="formato-btn active" id="fmtContratoDocx" onclick="setFormato('contrato','docx')">📄 Word (.docx)</button>
      <button class="formato-btn" id="fmtContratoPdf" onclick="setFormato('contrato','pdf')">📕 PDF</button>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-gerar" id="btnGerarContrato" onclick="gerarContrato()">
      <span class="btn-text" id="btnGerarContratoLabel">⬇ Baixar Contrato</span>
      <span class="spinner"></span>
    </button>
    <div class="msg" id="msgContrato"></div>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;text-align:center;">
      <button onclick="toggleHistoricoContrato()" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;">
        📋 Ver contratos salvos
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- HISTÓRICO CONTRATOS -->
  <div class="card" id="cardHistoricoContrato" style="display:none;">
    <div class="card-title" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;">
      <span>Contratos Salvos</span>
      <button onclick="toggleHistoricoContrato()" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-muted);">✕ Fechar</button>
    </div>
    <input class="hist-search" type="text" id="histSearchContrato" placeholder="🔍 Buscar por nome ou CNPJ..." oninput="renderHistoricoContrato()" />
    <div id="histListaContrato"></div>
  </div>

</div>
</div><!-- /pane-contrato -->

<!-- PAINEL DASHBOARD -->
<div id="pane-dashboard" class="tab-pane">

<!-- Header minimalista -->
<div style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:28px 0 24px;text-align:center;background:var(--surface);">
  <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:6px;">Gaideski Contabilidade</div>
  <h1 style="margin:0;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:-0.5px;">Dashboard Comercial</h1>
</div>

<div style="max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 16px 60px;">

  <!-- Filtros clean -->
  <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:28px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">
    <select id="dash_filtro_ano" onchange="renderDashboard()"
      style="height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);outline:none;cursor:pointer;">
      <option value="">Todos os anos</option>
    </select>
    <select id="dash_filtro_mes" onchange="renderDashboard()"
      style="height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);outline:none;cursor:pointer;">
      <option value="">Todos os meses</option>
    </select>
    <select id="dash_filtro_marca" onchange="renderDashboard()"
      style="height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);outline:none;cursor:pointer;">
      <option value="">Gaideski + Planicom</option>
      <option value="gaideski">Gaideski</option>
      <option value="planicom">Planicom</option>
    </select>
    <input type="text" id="dash_filtro_busca" oninput="renderDashboard()" placeholder="Buscar cliente..."
      style="height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;flex:1;min-width:180px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);outline:none;">
    <button onclick="exportarDashCSV()"
      style="height:36px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;">
      Exportar CSV
    </button>

// ── Seletor de formato ──────────────────────────────────────
var _formato = { orcamento: 'docx', contrato: 'docx' };

function setFormato(tipo, fmt) {
  _formato[tipo] = fmt;
  if (tipo === 'orcamento') {
    document.getElementById('fmtDocx').className = 'formato-btn' + (fmt==='docx' ? ' active' : '');
    document.getElementById('fmtPdf').className  = 'formato-btn' + (fmt==='pdf'  ? ' active' : '');
    document.getElementById('btnGerarLabel').textContent = fmt === 'pdf' ? '⬇ Baixar Orçamento PDF' : '⬇ Baixar Orçamento Word';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('fmtContratoDocx').className = 'formato-btn' + (fmt==='docx' ? ' active' : '');
    document.getElementById('fmtContratoPdf').className  = 'formato-btn' + (fmt==='pdf'  ? ' active' : '');
    document.getElementById('btnGerarContratoLabel').textContent = fmt === 'pdf' ? '⬇ Baixar Contrato PDF' : '⬇ Baixar Contrato Word';
  }
}

// Converter blob docx → PDF usando LibreOffice via servidor
// Como é offline, usamos impressão do browser como fallback para PDF
async function docxToPdfAndDownload(blob, filename) {
  // Abrir o docx num iframe oculto e imprimir como PDF
  // Melhor abordagem offline: converter via Word Online não está disponível
  // Usamos docx2pdf via uma conversão client-side com html intermediário
  // Solução prática: oferecer o docx e abrir diálogo de impressão
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  // Criar link temporário para download do docx
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename.replace('.pdf','.docx');

  // Mostrar modal explicando como salvar como PDF
  var overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
  var modal = document.createElement('div');
  modal.style.cssText = 'background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:32px;max-width:440px;width:90%;text-align:center;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;';
  modal.innerHTML =
    '<div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:12px;">📕</div>' +
    '<h3 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px;">Baixar como PDF</h3>' +
    '<p style="color:#666;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 20px;">O arquivo será baixado em Word. Para salvar como PDF:<br>' +
    '<strong>1.</strong> Abra o arquivo no Word<br>' +
    '<strong>2.</strong> Vá em <strong>Arquivo → Salvar como → PDF</strong><br>' +
    '<em>ou use</em> <strong>Ctrl+P → Salvar como PDF</strong></p>' +
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;">' +
    '<button id="pdfDownloadBtn" style="height:40px;padding:0 20px;background:#1A1A1A;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">⬇ Baixar Word</button>' +
    '<button id="pdfCancelBtn" style="height:40px;padding:0 16px;background:transparent;color:#666;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;">Cancelar</button>' +
    '</div>';
  overlay.appendChild(modal);
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  document.getElementById('pdfDownloadBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    document.body.removeChild(overlay);
  });
  document.getElementById('pdfCancelBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    document.body.removeChild(overlay);
  });
}

var FOLHA_2026 = [{max:5,custo:55},{max:10,custo:52},{max:20,custo:50},{max:30,custo:47},{max:50,custo:45},{max:70,custo:43},{max:100,custo:40},{max:999999,custo:38}];

// ── Seletor de empresa contrato ──────────────────────
var _empresaContrato = 'gaideski';

function selecionarEmpresa(empresa) {
  _empresaContrato = empresa;
  document.getElementById('radio_gaideski').checked = (empresa === 'gaideski');
  document.getElementById('radio_planicom').checked = (empresa === 'planicom');

  document.getElementById('lbl_planicom').classList.toggle('ativo', empresa === 'planicom');
}

function calcularHonorario() {
  var regime = document.getElementById('calc_regime').value;
  var fatStr = document.getElementById('calc_fat').value;
  var func = parseInt(document.getElementById('calc_func').value) || 0;
  var fat = parseMoedaCalc(fatStr);
  var tabela = TABELA_2026[regime];
  var base = 0;
  var desc = '';

  if (fat > 0 && tabela) {
    for (var i = 0; i < tabela.length; i++) {
      if (fat <= tabela[i].max) { base = tabela[i].val; break; }
    }
    if (base === 0 && regime === 'lr') {
      // Acima de 2mi: +1 salário por 500mil
      base = 6485.93 + Math.ceil((fat - 2000000) / 500000) * 1621;
    }
    if (base === 0 && tabela.length > 0) base = tabela[tabela.length-1].val;
  }

  var folha = 0;
  if (func > 0) {
    for (var j = 0; j < FOLHA_2026.length; j++) {
      if (func <= FOLHA_2026[j].max) { folha = func * FOLHA_2026[j].custo; break; }
    }
    if (folha === 0) folha = func * 38;
  }

  var total = base + folha;
  var valorEl = document.getElementById('calc_valor');
  var descEl  = document.getElementById('calc_desc');
  var btnUsar = document.getElementById('btnUsarValor');
  if (total > 0) {
    var partes = [];
    if (base > 0) partes.push('Honorário: ' + formatMoedaCalc(base));
    if (folha > 0) partes.push('Folha (' + func + ' func.): ' + formatMoedaCalc(folha));
    valorEl.textContent = formatMoedaCalc(total);
    descEl.textContent  = partes.join(' + ');
    btnUsar.style.display = 'inline-block';
    // Guardar dados para usar no orçamento
    window._calcResultado = { base: base, folha: folha, total: total, func: func, regime: regime };
  } else {
    valorEl.textContent = '—';
    descEl.textContent  = 'Preencha o faturamento acima';
    btnUsar.style.display = 'none';
    window._calcResultado = null;
  }
}

function usarValorNoOrcamento() {
  var r = window._calcResultado;
  if (!r) return;

  var regime = document.getElementById('calc_regime').value;
  var fat    = document.getElementById('calc_fat').value.trim();

  // Ir para a aba de orçamentos
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.getElementById('pane-orcamento').classList.add('active');
  document.querySelector('.tab-btn').classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

  // Marcar o serviço correto e preencher valor
  var mapeamento = {
    'sn_ind':  'svcSimples',
    'sn_serv': 'svcSimples',
    'sn_misto':'svcSimples',
    'lp':      'svcSimples',
    'lr':      'svcLucroReal',
  };
  var svcId = mapeamento[regime] || 'svcSimples';

  // Desmarcar tudo e marcar o correto
  ['svcLucroReal','svcSimples','svcAbertura','svcCNPJ'].forEach(function(id){
    document.getElementById(id).checked = false;
  });
  document.getElementById(svcId).checked = true;

  // Preencher valor do honorário
  if (svcId === 'svcLucroReal') {
    document.getElementById('valLucroReal').value = formatMoedaCalc(r.base);
    if (fat) document.getElementById('fatLucroReal').value = fat;
  } else {
    document.getElementById('valSimples').value = formatMoedaCalc(r.base);
  }

  // Se tem folha, ativar item personalizado
  if (r.folha > 0 && r.func > 0) {
    document.getElementById('svcLivre').checked = true;
    // Limpar itens anteriores
    document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').innerHTML = '';
    itemLivreCount = 0;
    // Adicionar item de folha
    adicionarItemLivre();
    setTimeout(function() {
      var cards = document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').children;
      if (cards.length > 0) {
        var card = cards[0];
        var inDesc = card.querySelector('.item-desc');
        var inVal  = card.querySelector('.item-val');
        if (inDesc) inDesc.value = 'Folha de Pagamento (' + r.func + ' funcionário' + (r.func > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')';
        if (inVal)  inVal.value  = formatMoedaCalc(r.folha);
        // Confirmar o item automaticamente
        setTimeout(function(){ confirmarItemLivre(card.id); }, 100);
      }
    }, 100);
  }

  toggleServico();

  setTimeout(function(){
    mostrarMsg('✓ Valores da tabela de honorários aplicados ao orçamento!', 'success');
  }, 400);
}

function parseMoedaCalc(str) {
  if (!str) return 0;
  return parseFloat(str.replace(/[R$\s.]/g,'').replace(',','.')) || 0;
}
function formatMoedaCalc(val) {
  return 'R$ ' + val.toFixed(2).replace('.',',').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,'.');
}

function formatMoedaAC(val) {
  if (!val && val !== 0) return '';
  return 'R$ ' + Number(val).toFixed(2).replace('.',',').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,'.');
}

function criarAutocomplete(inputEl, valInputEl) {
  // Wrapper
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.className = 'ac-wrap';
  inputEl.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, inputEl);
  wrap.appendChild(inputEl);

  // Lista dropdown
  var lista = document.createElement('div');
  lista.className = 'ac-list';
  wrap.appendChild(lista);

  var selectedIdx = -1;
  var filtered = [];

  function renderLista(q) {
    q = (q || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    filtered = q.length < 1
      ? CATALOGO_SERVICOS
      : CATALOGO_SERVICOS.filter(function(s){
          return s.nome.toLowerCase().includes(q) || s.dept.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        });

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      lista.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;color:#888880;">Nenhum serviço encontrado. Digite livremente.</div>';
      lista.classList.add('open');
      return;
    }

    // Agrupar por dept
    var grupos = {};
    var ordem = [];
    filtered.forEach(function(s, i) {
      if (!grupos[s.dept]) { grupos[s.dept] = []; ordem.push(s.dept); }
      grupos[s.dept].push({s: s, i: i});
    });

    var html = '';
    ordem.forEach(function(dept) {
      html += '<div style="padding:6px 14px 2px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.8px;color:#AAAAAA;text-transform:uppercase;background:#F9F8F5;border-bottom:1px solid #F0EEE8;">' + dept + '</div>';
      grupos[dept].forEach(function(obj) {
        html += '<div class="ac-item" data-idx="' + obj.i + '">' +
          '<div class="ac-item-nome">' + obj.s.nome + '</div>' +
          (obj.s.valor ? '<span class="ac-item-valor">' + formatMoedaAC(obj.s.valor) + '</span>' : '<span class="ac-item-valor" style="color:#AAAAAA;">A avaliar</span>') +
          '</div>';
      });
    });

    lista.innerHTML = html;
    lista.querySelectorAll('.ac-item').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        selecionarItem(parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-idx')));
      });
    });
    selectedIdx = -1;
    lista.classList.add('open');
  }

  function selecionarItem(idx) {
    var item = filtered[idx];
    if (!item) return;
    inputEl.value = item.nome;
    if (valInputEl && item.valor) {
      valInputEl.value = formatMoedaAC(item.valor);
      valInputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
    }
    lista.classList.remove('open');
    inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
  }

  inputEl.addEventListener('input', function() {
    renderLista(inputEl.value);
  });
  inputEl.addEventListener('focus', function() {
    renderLista(inputEl.value);
  });
  inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    var items = lista.querySelectorAll('.ac-item');
    if (!lista.classList.contains('open') || items.length === 0) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      selectedIdx = Math.min(selectedIdx + 1, items.length - 1);
      items.forEach(function(el, i){ el.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedIdx); });
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      selectedIdx = Math.max(selectedIdx - 1, 0);
      items.forEach(function(el, i){ el.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedIdx); });
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      selecionarItem(selectedIdx);
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      lista.classList.remove('open');
    }
  });
  inputEl.addEventListener('blur', function() {
    setTimeout(function(){ lista.classList.remove('open'); }, 150);
  });
}

var _marcaOrc = 'gaideski';

function selecionarMarcaOrc(marca) {
  _marcaOrc = marca;
  var isGaid = (marca === 'gaideski');
  // Botões
  var btnG = document.getElementById('marcaBtn_gaideski');
  var btnP = document.getElementById('marcaBtn_planicom');
  if (btnG) {
    btnG.style.borderBottomColor = isGaid ? '#1B5EA6' : 'transparent';
    btnG.style.color = isGaid ? '#1B5EA6' : 'var(--text-muted)';
    btnG.style.fontWeight = isGaid ? '700' : '600';
  }
  if (btnP) {
    btnP.style.borderBottomColor = !isGaid ? '#1D7A3A' : 'transparent';
    btnP.style.color = !isGaid ? '#1D7A3A' : 'var(--text-muted)';
    btnP.style.fontWeight = !isGaid ? '700' : '600';
  }
  // Logo e textos do header
  var logo = document.getElementById('orc_logo');
  var titulo = document.getElementById('orc_titulo');
  var sub = document.getElementById('orc_subtitulo');
  if (logo) {
    if (isGaid) {
      logo.src = 'data:image/png;base64,' + LOGO_B64;
    } else {
      logo.src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + PLANICON_LOGO_B64;
    }
  }
  if (titulo) titulo.textContent = isGaid ? 'Gerador de Orçamentos' : 'Gerador de Orçamentos';
  if (sub) sub.textContent = isGaid
    ? 'Preencha os dados do cliente e gere o documento .docx automaticamente'
    : 'Preencha os dados do cliente e gere o documento .docx automaticamente';
}

function parseMoeda(str) {
  if (!str) return 0;
  return parseFloat(str.replace(/[R$\s\.]/g, '').replace(',', '.')) || 0;
}

function formatMoeda(val) {
  return 'R$ ' + val.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
}

function toggleServico() {
  const lr = document.getElementById('svcLucroReal').checked;
  const sn = document.getElementById('svcSimples').checked;
  const ab = document.getElementById('svcAbertura').checked;
  const cn = document.getElementById('svcCNPJ').checked;
  const lv = document.getElementById('svcLivre').checked;

  const algum = lr || sn || ab || cn || lv;
  document.getElementById('valoresPanel').classList.toggle('visible', algum);

  document.getElementById('rowLucroReal').style.display = lr ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('rowSimples').style.display = sn ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('rowAbertura').style.display = ab ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('rowCNPJ').style.display = cn ? 'flex' : 'none';
  // (display flex já definido inline para os novos cards com obs)
  document.getElementById('rowLivre').style.display = lv ? 'flex' : 'none';
  if (lv && document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').children.length === 0) adicionarItemLivre();

  atualizarResumo();
}

function atualizarResumo() {
  const lr = document.getElementById('svcLucroReal').checked;
  const sn = document.getElementById('svcSimples').checked;
  const ab = document.getElementById('svcAbertura').checked;
  const cn = document.getElementById('svcCNPJ').checked;
  const lv = document.getElementById('svcLivre').checked;

  if (!lr && !sn && !ab && !cn && !lv) {
    document.getElementById('cardResumo').style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }

  let linhas = [];
  let totalBruto = 0;
  let totalDesconto = 0;

  if (lr) {
    const v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valLucroReal').value);
    linhas.push({ label: 'Honorário Mensal — Lucro Real', valor: v });
    totalBruto += v;
  }
  if (sn) {
    const v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valSimples').value);
    linhas.push({ label: 'Honorário Mensal — Simples Nacional', valor: v });
    totalBruto += v;
  }
  if (ab) {
    const v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valAbertura').value);
    linhas.push({ label: 'Abertura de Empresa', valor: v });
    totalBruto += v;
  }
  if (cn) {
    const v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valCNPJ').value);
    linhas.push({ label: 'Compra de CNPJ', valor: v });
    totalBruto += v;
  }
  if (lv) {
    getItensLivres().forEach(function(item) {
      if (item.desc && item.val > 0) {
        linhas.push({ label: item.desc, valor: item.val });
        totalBruto += item.val;
        if (item.temDesc) {
          const desc = item.val - item.valFinal;
          linhas.push({ label: 'Desconto ' + item.pct + '% — ' + item.desc, valor: desc, desconto: true });
          totalDesconto += desc;
        }
      }
    });
  }

  let html = linhas.map(function(l) {
    return '<div class="resumo-linha">' +
      '<span class="label">' + l.label + '</span>' +
      '<span style="' + (l.desconto ? 'color:#C0392B' : '') + '">' +
      (l.desconto ? '— ' + formatMoeda(l.valor) : formatMoeda(l.valor)) +
      '</span></div>';
  }).join('');

  // Linha de subtotal só aparece se houver desconto
  if (totalDesconto > 0) {
    html += '<div class="resumo-linha" style="padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #E2E0DA;margin-top:4px;">' +
      '<span class="label">Subtotal</span><span>' + formatMoeda(totalBruto) + '</span></div>';
    html += '<div class="resumo-linha">' +
      '<span class="label" style="color:#C0392B;">Total de descontos</span>' +
      '<span style="color:#C0392B;">— ' + formatMoeda(totalDesconto) + '</span></div>';
  }

  const totalFinal = totalBruto - totalDesconto;
  html += '<div class="resumo-linha total"><span class="label">TOTAL GERAL</span><span>' + formatMoeda(totalFinal) + '</span></div>';

  document.getElementById('resumoContent').innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById('cardResumo').style.display = 'block';
}

  const ab = document.getElementById('svcAbertura').checked;
  const cn = document.getElementById('svcCNPJ').checked;
  const lv = document.getElementById('svcLivre').checked;
  if (!lr && !sn && !ab && !cn && !lv) {
    mostrarMsg('Selecione pelo menos um serviço.', 'error');

      new Paragraph({ children: [b("ÁREA TRABALHISTA E PREVIDENCIÁRIA", 18)], spacing: { before: 80, after: 30 } }),

        margins: { top: 100, bottom: 100, left: 100, right: 100 },
        verticalAlign: VerticalAlign.CENTER,

      const resumoRows = [

      linhasResumo.forEach(function(row, i) {
        const bg = i % 2 === 1 ? "FAFAFA" : BRANCO;

      // Linha subtotal (só se houver desconto)
      if (totalGeralDesconto > 0) {
        resumoRows.push(new TableRow({ children: [

        resumoRows.push(new TableRow({ children: [

        ]}));
      }

      // Linha TOTAL GERAL
      resumoRows.push(new TableRow({ children: [
        totCellR("TOTAL GERAL", colsR[0], AlignmentType.RIGHT, true, true),
        totCellR(formatMoeda(totalGeralBruto), colsR[1], AlignmentType.RIGHT, true, true),
        totCellR(formatMoeda(totalGeralFinal), colsR[2], AlignmentType.RIGHT, true, true),

      const tabelaResumo = new Table({ width: { size: CONTENT_W, type: WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: colsR, rows: resumoRows });

      children.push(divider(), sp(20));

    // ── FIM RESUMO GERAL ─────────────────────────────────────

    const doc = new Document({
      numbering: { config: [{ reference: "bullets", levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.BULLET, text: "›", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT, style: { run: { font: "Calibri", color: PRETO, size: 18 }, paragraph: { indent: { left: 480, hanging: 240 }, spacing: { before: 20, after: 20 } } } }] }] },
      styles: { default: { document: { run: { font: "Calibri", size: 18, color: PRETO } } } },
      sections: [{ properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 1000, right: 1000, bottom: 1000, left: 1000 } } }, children }]
    });

    const blob = await Packer.toBlob(doc);
    const filename = 'Orcamento_Gaideski_' + num + '_' + nome.replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (_formato.orcamento === 'pdf') {
      await docxToPdfAndDownload(blob, filename + '.pdf');
    } else {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url; a.download = filename + '.docx';
      a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    salvarNumeroUsado(num);
    salvarNoHistorico(coletarDadosParaHistorico());
    resetarFormulario();

    mostrarMsg('Erro ao gerar o documento: ' + e.message, 'error');
  } finally {

    btn.disabled = false;
