function base64ToArrayBuffer(base64) {
  var bStr = atob(base64);
  var bytes = new Uint8Array(bStr.length);
  for (var i = 0; i < bStr.length; i++) bytes[i] = bStr.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes.buffer;
}
function base64ToUint8Array(base64) {
  const binary = atob(base64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}

function formatarData(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  const [y, m, d] = dateStr.split('-');
  const meses = ['janeiro','fevereiro','março','abril','maio','junho','julho','agosto','setembro','outubro','novembro','dezembro'];
  return parseInt(d) + ' de ' + meses[parseInt(m)-1] + ' de ' + y;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HISTÓRICO DE ORÇAMENTOS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function getHistorico() {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gaideski_historico') || '[]'); }
  catch(e) { return []; }
}

function salvarNoHistorico(dados) {
  var hist = getHistorico();
  // Atualizar se já existe mesmo número
  var idx = hist.findIndex(function(h){ return h.num === dados.num; });
  if (idx >= 0) hist[idx] = dados;
  else hist.unshift(dados); // mais recente primeiro
  // Máximo 200 registros
  if (hist.length > 200) hist = hist.slice(0, 200);
  localStorage.setItem('gaideski_historico', JSON.stringify(hist));
}

function toggleHistorico() {
  var card = document.getElementById('cardHistorico');
  var visible = card.style.display !== 'none';
  card.style.display = visible ? 'none' : 'block';
  if (!visible) {
    renderHistorico();
    document.getElementById('histSearch').value = '';
    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }
}

function renderHistorico() {
  var q = (document.getElementById('histSearch').value || '').toLowerCase();
  var hist = getHistorico().filter(function(h) {
    return !q || h.num.toLowerCase().includes(q) || h.nome.toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });
  var lista = document.getElementById('histLista');
  if (hist.length === 0) {
    lista.innerHTML = '<div class="hist-empty">' + (q ? 'Nenhum orçamento encontrado.' : 'Nenhum orçamento salvo ainda.') + '</div>';
    return;
  }
  lista.innerHTML = hist.map(function(h, i) {
    return '<div class="hist-item" onclick="carregarOrcamento(' + i + ')">' +
      '<span class="hist-num">' + h.num + '</span>' +
      '<div class="hist-info">' +
        '<div class="hist-nome">' + h.nome + '</div>' +
        '<div class="hist-meta">' + h.data + ' · ' + h.servicos + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<span class="hist-valor">' + h.totalFmt + '</span>' +
      '<button class="hist-del" onclick="deletarOrcamento(event,' + i + ')" title="Excluir">×</button>' +
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function deletarOrcamento(e, idx) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  var q = (document.getElementById('histSearch').value || '').toLowerCase();
  var hist = getHistorico();
  var filtrado = hist.filter(function(h) {
    return !q || h.num.toLowerCase().includes(q) || h.nome.toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });
  var item = filtrado[idx];
  if (!item) return;
  if (!confirm('Excluir orçamento ' + item.num + ' de ' + item.nome + '?')) return;
  var idxReal = hist.findIndex(function(h){ return h.num === item.num && h.nome === item.nome; });
  if (idxReal >= 0) hist.splice(idxReal, 1);
  localStorage.setItem('gaideski_historico', JSON.stringify(hist));
  renderHistorico();
}

function carregarOrcamento(idx) {
  var q = (document.getElementById('histSearch').value || '').toLowerCase();
  var hist = getHistorico();
  var filtrado = hist.filter(function(h) {
    return !q || h.num.toLowerCase().includes(q) || h.nome.toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });
  var h = filtrado[idx];
  if (!h) return;

  // Fechar histórico
  document.getElementById('cardHistorico').style.display = 'none';

  // Preencher dados do cliente
  document.getElementById('nomeCliente').value = h.nome || '';
  document.getElementById('numOrcamento').value = h.num || '';
  document.getElementById('dataOrcamento').value = h.dataISO || '';

  // Desmarcar tudo primeiro
  ['svcLucroReal','svcSimples','svcAbertura','svcCNPJ','svcLivre'].forEach(function(id){
    document.getElementById(id).checked = false;
  });
  document.getElementById('valoresPanel').classList.remove('visible');
  ['rowLucroReal','rowSimples','rowAbertura','rowCNPJ','rowLivre'].forEach(function(id){
    document.getElementById(id).style.display = 'none';
  });
  document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').innerHTML = '';
  itemLivreCount = 0;

  // Restaurar serviços
  var svcs = h.svcs || {};
  if (svcs.lr) {
    document.getElementById('svcLucroReal').checked = true;
    document.getElementById('valLucroReal').value = svcs.lr.val || '';
    document.getElementById('fatLucroReal').value = svcs.lr.fat || '';
    document.getElementById('obsLucroReal').value = svcs.lr.obs || '';
  }
  if (svcs.sn) {
    document.getElementById('svcSimples').checked = true;
    document.getElementById('valSimples').value = svcs.sn.val || '';
    document.getElementById('obsSimples').value = svcs.sn.obs || '';
  }
  if (svcs.ab) {
    document.getElementById('svcAbertura').checked = true;
    document.getElementById('valAbertura').value = svcs.ab.val || '';
    document.getElementById('obsAbertura').value = svcs.ab.obs || '';
  }
  if (svcs.cn) {
    document.getElementById('svcCNPJ').checked = true;
    document.getElementById('valCNPJ').value = svcs.cn.val || '';
    document.getElementById('obsCNPJ').value = svcs.cn.obs || '';
  }
  if (svcs.livre && svcs.livre.length > 0) {
    document.getElementById('svcLivre').checked = true;
    svcs.livre.forEach(function(item) {
      adicionarItemLivre();
      var cards = document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').children;
      var card = cards[cards.length - 1];
      card.querySelector('.item-desc').value = item.desc || '';
      card.querySelector('.item-detalhe').value = item.detalhe || '';
      card.querySelector('.item-val').value = item.valFmt || '';
      if (item.temDesc) {
        var chk = card.querySelector('.item-chk-desc');
        chk.checked = true;
        card.querySelector('.item-pct-desc').value = item.pct || 10;
        atualizarDescItemLivre(card.id);
      }
    });
  }

  toggleServico();
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  mostrarMsg('Orçamento ' + h.num + ' carregado para edição!', 'success');
}

function coletarDadosParaHistorico() {
  var lr = document.getElementById('svcLucroReal').checked;
  var sn = document.getElementById('svcSimples').checked;
  var ab = document.getElementById('svcAbertura').checked;
  var cn = document.getElementById('svcCNPJ').checked;
  var lv = document.getElementById('svcLivre').checked;

  var svcs = {};
  var labels = [];
  var total = 0;

  if (lr) {
    var v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valLucroReal').value);
    svcs.lr = { val: document.getElementById('valLucroReal').value, fat: document.getElementById('fatLucroReal').value, obs: document.getElementById('obsLucroReal').value };
    labels.push('Lucro Real'); total += v;
  }
  if (sn) {
    var v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valSimples').value);
    svcs.sn = { val: document.getElementById('valSimples').value, obs: document.getElementById('obsSimples').value };
    labels.push('Simples Nacional'); total += v;
  }
  if (ab) {
    var v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valAbertura').value);
    svcs.ab = { val: document.getElementById('valAbertura').value, obs: document.getElementById('obsAbertura').value };
    labels.push('Abertura'); total += v;
  }
  if (cn) {
    var v = parseMoeda(document.getElementById('valCNPJ').value);
    svcs.cn = { val: document.getElementById('valCNPJ').value, obs: document.getElementById('obsCNPJ').value };
    labels.push('Compra CNPJ'); total += v;
  }
  if (lv) {
    var itens = getItensLivres().filter(function(i){ return i.desc && i.val > 0; });
    svcs.livre = itens.map(function(i){ return { desc: i.desc, detalhe: i.detalhe, valFmt: formatMoeda(i.val), temDesc: i.temDesc, pct: i.pct }; });
    itens.forEach(function(i){ total += i.valFinal; labels.push(i.desc); });
  }

  var hoje = new Date();
  var dataISO = document.getElementById('dataOrcamento').value || hoje.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  var dataFmt = formatarData(dataISO);

  return {
    num: document.getElementById('numOrcamento').value,
    nome: document.getElementById('nomeCliente').value,
    data: dataFmt,
    dataISO: dataISO,
    servicos: labels.join(', ') || 'Sem serviços',
    totalFmt: formatMoeda(total),
    total: total,
    svcs: svcs,
    marca: _marcaOrc || 'gaideski',
    ts: Date.now()
  };
}

function resetarFormulario() {
  // Dados do cliente
  document.getElementById('nomeCliente').value = '';
  document.getElementById('numOrcamento').value = gerarNumeroAuto();
  document.getElementById('dataOrcamento').valueAsDate = new Date();

  // Desmarcar todos os serviços
  ['svcLucroReal','svcSimples','svcAbertura','svcCNPJ','svcLivre'].forEach(function(id) {
    document.getElementById(id).checked = false;
  });

  // Esconder painel de valores
  document.getElementById('valoresPanel').classList.remove('visible');

  // Esconder todas as linhas
  ['rowLucroReal','rowSimples','rowAbertura','rowCNPJ','rowLivre'].forEach(function(id) {
    document.getElementById(id).style.display = 'none';
  });

  // Resetar valores para defaults
  document.getElementById('valLucroReal').value = 'R$ 2.813,00';
  document.getElementById('fatLucroReal').value = '';
  document.getElementById('obsLucroReal').value = '';
  document.getElementById('valSimples').value = 'R$ 810,00';
  document.getElementById('obsSimples').value = '';
  document.getElementById('valAbertura').value = 'R$ 1.836,00';
  document.getElementById('obsAbertura').value = '';
  document.getElementById('valCNPJ').value = 'R$ 3.500,00';
  document.getElementById('obsCNPJ').value = '';

  // Limpar itens livres
  document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').innerHTML = '';
  itemLivreCount = 0;

  // Esconder resumo
  document.getElementById('cardResumo').style.display = 'none';

  // Scroll para o topo
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function mostrarMsg(text, tipo) {
  const el = document.getElementById('msg');
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'msg ' + tipo;
  setTimeout(() => el.className = 'msg', 5000);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// HISTÓRICO DE CONTRATOS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
function getHistoricoContrato() {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gaideski_contratos') || '[]'); }
  catch(e) { return []; }
}
function salvarNoHistoricoContrato(dados) {
  var hist = getHistoricoContrato();
  var idx = hist.findIndex(function(h){ return h.cnpj === dados.cnpj && h.nome === dados.nome; });
  if (idx >= 0) hist[idx] = dados;
  else hist.unshift(dados);
  if (hist.length > 200) hist = hist.slice(0,200);
  localStorage.setItem('gaideski_contratos', JSON.stringify(hist));
}
function toggleHistoricoContrato() {
  var card = document.getElementById('cardHistoricoContrato');
  var visible = card.style.display !== 'none';
  card.style.display = visible ? 'none' : 'block';
  if (!visible) {
    renderHistoricoContrato();
    document.getElementById('histSearchContrato').value = '';
    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
  }
}
function renderHistoricoContrato() {
  var q = (document.getElementById('histSearchContrato').value || '').toLowerCase();
  var hist = getHistoricoContrato().filter(function(h){
    return !q || (h.nome||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (h.cnpj||'').includes(q);
  });
  var lista = document.getElementById('histListaContrato');
  if (hist.length === 0) {
    lista.innerHTML = '<div class="hist-empty">' + (q ? 'Nenhum contrato encontrado.' : 'Nenhum contrato salvo ainda.') + '</div>';
    return;
  }
  lista.innerHTML = hist.map(function(h, i) {
    var badgeEmpresa = h.empresa === 'planicom'
    ? '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;background:#F0FDF4;color:#1D7A3A;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:4px;margin-right:6px;">PLANICOM</span>'
    : '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;background:#EFF6FF;color:#1B5EA6;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:4px;margin-right:6px;">GAIDESKI</span>';
  return '<div class="hist-item" onclick="carregarContrato(' + i + ')">' +
      '<span class="hist-num" style="background:#EEF2FF;">' + (h.cnpj||'—') + '</span>' +
      '<div class="hist-info">' +
        '<div class="hist-nome">' + badgeEmpresa + (h.nome||'') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="hist-meta">' + (h.regime||'') + ' · ' + (h.vigencia||'') + ' · ' + (h.remuneracao||'') + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<button class="hist-del" onclick="deletarContrato(event,' + i + ')" title="Excluir">×</button>' +
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}
function deletarContrato(e, idx) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  var q = (document.getElementById('histSearchContrato').value||'').toLowerCase();
  var hist = getHistoricoContrato();
  var filtrado = hist.filter(function(h){ return !q || (h.nome||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (h.cnpj||'').includes(q); });
  var item = filtrado[idx];
  if (!item) return;
  if (!confirm('Excluir contrato de ' + item.nome + '?')) return;
  var idxReal = hist.findIndex(function(h){ return h.cnpj===item.cnpj && h.nome===item.nome; });
  if (idxReal >= 0) hist.splice(idxReal, 1);
  localStorage.setItem('gaideski_contratos', JSON.stringify(hist));
  renderHistoricoContrato();
}
function carregarContrato(idx) {
  var q = (document.getElementById('histSearchContrato').value||'').toLowerCase();
  var hist = getHistoricoContrato().filter(function(h){ return !q || (h.nome||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (h.cnpj||'').includes(q); });
  var h = hist[idx];
  if (!h) return;
  document.getElementById('cardHistoricoContrato').style.display = 'none';
  // Preencher todos os campos
  if (h.empresa) selecionarEmpresa(h.empresa);
  var map = {
    c_nome: h.nome, c_cnpj: h.cnpj, c_endereco: h.endereco,
    c_rep: h.rep, c_cpf: h.cpf, c_cargo: h.cargo||'ADMINISTRADOR',
    c_objeto: h.objeto, c_folha: h.folha||'Sem folha',
    c_vigencia: h.vigencia, c_faturamento: h.faturamento,
    c_remuneracao: h.remuneracao, c_vencimento: h.vencimento||'05'
  };
  Object.keys(map).forEach(function(id){
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el && map[id]) el.value = map[id];
  });
  // Mostrar aviso de endereço preenchido
  var endEl = document.getElementById('c_endereco');
  var endAviso = document.getElementById('c_endereco_aviso');
  var endPreview = document.getElementById('c_endereco_preview');
  if (endEl && endEl.value && endAviso) {
    endAviso.style.display = 'inline';
    if (endPreview) {
      endPreview.style.display = 'block';
      endPreview.textContent = '📍 Atual: ' + endEl.value;
    }
  }
  // Regime (select)
  var sel = document.getElementById('c_regime');
  if (sel && h.regime) {
    for (var i=0; i<sel.options.length; i++) {
      if (sel.options[i].value === h.regime) { sel.selectedIndex = i; break; }
    }
  }
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior:'smooth' });
  mostrarMsgContrato('Contrato de ' + h.nome + ' carregado para edição!', 'success');
}

function mostrarMsgContrato(text, tipo) {
  const el = document.getElementById('msgContrato');
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'msg ' + tipo;
  setTimeout(() => { el.className = 'msg'; }, 6000);
}

// ── Dashboard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var _dashEditIdx = -1;

function renderDashboard() {
  var MESES_NOMES = ['Janeiro','Fevereiro','Março','Abril','Maio','Junho','Julho','Agosto','Setembro','Outubro','Novembro','Dezembro'];

  // Coletar dados
  var orcs = getHistorico().map(function(h){ return Object.assign({}, h, {_tipo:'orc'}); });
  var conts = getHistoricoContrato().map(function(h){ return Object.assign({}, h, {_tipo:'cont', nome: h.nome, total: parseMoeda(h.remuneracao||'0'), totalFmt: h.remuneracao||'—', dataISO: h.data, ts: h.ts||0, marca: h.empresa||'gaideski'}); });

  // Filtros
  var anoSel   = (document.getElementById('dash_filtro_ano')||{}).value || '';
  var mesSel   = (document.getElementById('dash_filtro_mes')||{}).value || '';
  var tipoSel  = (document.getElementById('dash_filtro_tipo')||{}).value || '';
  var marcaSel = (document.getElementById('dash_filtro_marca')||{}).value || '';
  var busca    = ((document.getElementById('dash_filtro_busca')||{}).value || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  // Preencher selects de ano e mês
  var todos = orcs.concat(conts);
  var anos = [...new Set(todos.map(function(h){ return (h.dataISO||'').slice(0,4); }).filter(Boolean))].sort().reverse();
  var selAno = document.getElementById('dash_filtro_ano');
  var selMes = document.getElementById('dash_filtro_mes');
  if (selAno && selAno.options.length <= 1) {
    anos.forEach(function(a){ var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=a; o.textContent=a; selAno.appendChild(o); });
  }
  if (selMes && selMes.options.length <= 1) {
    MESES_NOMES.forEach(function(m,i){ var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'); o.textContent=m; selMes.appendChild(o); });
  }

  // Só orçamentos
  var combinado = orcs.slice();

  var filtrado = combinado.filter(function(h) {
    var ok = true;
    if (anoSel)   ok = ok && (h.dataISO||'').slice(0,4) === anoSel;
    if (mesSel)   ok = ok && (h.dataISO||'').slice(5,7) === mesSel;
    if (marcaSel) ok = ok && (h.marca||'gaideski') === marcaSel;
    if (busca)    ok = ok && (h.nome||'').toLowerCase().includes(busca);
    return ok;
  });

  filtrado.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.ts||0)-(a.ts||0); });

  // === CARDS RESUMO ===
  var totalOrc  = filtrado.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='orc'; }).length;
  var totalCont = filtrado.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='cont'; }).length;
  var somaOrc   = filtrado.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='orc'; }).reduce(function(s,h){ return s+(h.total||0); },0);
  var somaCont  = filtrado.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='cont'; }).reduce(function(s,h){ return s+(h.total||0); },0);
  var mesAtual  = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7);
  var countMes  = filtrado.filter(function(h){ return (h.dataISO||'').slice(0,7)===mesAtual; }).length;

  var cardsEl = document.getElementById('dash_cards');
  // Calcular ticket médio
  var ticketMedio = totalOrc > 0 ? somaOrc / totalOrc : 0;
  if (cardsEl) cardsEl.innerHTML =
    dashCard('📄','Orçamentos emitidos', totalOrc, '', '#1B5EA6','#EFF6FF') +
    dashCard('💰','Total proposto', '', formatMoeda(somaOrc), '#7C3AED','#F5F3FF') +
    dashCard('📅','Este mês', countMes, '', '#B45309','#FFFBEB') +
    dashCard('📊','Ticket médio', '', formatMoeda(ticketMedio), '#0891B2','#ECFEFF');

  // === TABELA AGRUPADA POR MÊS/ANO ===
  // Agrupar
  var grupos = {};
  filtrado.forEach(function(h) {
    var key = (h.dataISO||'').slice(0,7); // YYYY-MM
    if (!key) key = '0000-00';
    if (!grupos[key]) grupos[key] = [];
    grupos[key].push(h);
  });

  var keysOrdenadas = Object.keys(grupos).sort().reverse();
  var html_out = '';

  if (keysOrdenadas.length === 0) {
    html_out = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:14px;">Nenhum registro encontrado para os filtros selecionados.</div>';
  }

  keysOrdenadas.forEach(function(key) {
    var itens = grupos[key];
    var ano = key.slice(0,4);
    var mes = parseInt(key.slice(5,7)) - 1;
    var mesNome = MESES_NOMES[mes] || key;
    var titulo = key === '0000-00' ? 'Sem data' : (mesNome + ' de ' + ano);
    var subtotal = itens.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='orc'; }).reduce(function(s,h){ return s+(h.total||0); },0);
    var nOrcs = itens.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='orc'; }).length;
    var nConts = itens.filter(function(h){ return h._tipo==='cont'; }).length;

    html_out += '<div style="margin-bottom:24px;">';
    // Header do período
    html_out += '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--tag-bg);border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:none;">';
    html_out += '<div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);">📅 ' + titulo + '</div>';
    html_out += '<div style="display:flex;gap:16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">';
    if (nOrcs) html_out += '<span>📄 ' + nOrcs + ' orçamento' + (nOrcs>1?'s':'') + '</span>';
    if (nConts) html_out += '<span>📝 ' + nConts + ' contrato' + (nConts>1?'s':'') + '</span>';
    if (subtotal > 0) html_out += '<span style="font-weight:600;color:var(--text);">💰 ' + formatMoeda(subtotal) + '</span>';
    html_out += '</div></div>';

    // Tabela
    html_out += '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;border:1px solid var(--border);border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:20px;">';
    html_out += '<thead><tr style="background:var(--tag-bg);">';

    html_out += '<th style="padding:9px 16px;text-align:left;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">Cliente</th>';
    html_out += '<th style="padding:9px 16px;text-align:left;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">Empresa</th>';
    html_out += '<th style="padding:9px 16px;text-align:left;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">Serviço</th>';
    html_out += '<th style="padding:9px 16px;text-align:right;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">Valor</th>';
    html_out += '<th style="padding:9px 16px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">Data</th>';
    html_out += '<th style="padding:9px 16px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);"></th>';
    html_out += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    itens.forEach(function(h, idx) {
      var bg = idx % 2 === 1 ? 'background:var(--tag-bg);' : '';
      var isOrc = h._tipo === 'orc';
      var tipoBadge = isOrc
        ? '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;background:#EFF6FF;color:#1B5EA6;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;">ORÇAMENTO</span>'
        : '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;background:#F0FDF4;color:#1D7A3A;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;">CONTRATO</span>';
      var marcaBadge = (h.marca||'gaideski') === 'planicom'
        ? '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#1D7A3A;">PLN</span>'
        : '<span style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#1B5EA6;">GAI</span>';
      var servico = isOrc ? (h.servicos||'—') : ((h.regime||'') + (h.objeto ? ' · ' + h.objeto.slice(0,30) : ''));
      var valor = isOrc ? (h.totalFmt||'—') : (h.remuneracao||'—');
      var dataFmt = (h.dataISO||'').split('-').reverse().join('/') || '—';

      html_out += '<tr style="' + bg + '">';
      html_out += '<td style="padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);">' + (h.nome||'—') + '</td>';
      html_out += '<td style="padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">' + marcaBadge + '</td>';
      html_out += '<td style="padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);max-width:220px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">' + servico + '</td>';
      html_out += '<td style="padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:right;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--text);">' + valor + '</td>';
      html_out += '<td style="padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap;">' + dataFmt + '</td>';
      var idxGlobal = getHistorico().findIndex(function(x){ return x.ts === h.ts; });
      html_out += '<td style="padding:8px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;">' +
        '<button onclick="abrirModalDash(' + idxGlobal + ')" title="Editar" style="background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;width:28px;height:26px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-right:4px;">✎</button>' +
        '<button onclick="excluirDash(' + idxGlobal + ')" title="Excluir" style="background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;width:28px;height:26px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:#aaa;">×</button>' +
        '</td>';
      html_out += '</tr>';
    });

    html_out += '</tbody></table></div>';
  });

  var corpo = document.getElementById('dash_corpo');
  if (corpo) corpo.innerHTML = html_out;
}

function dashCard(icon, label, num, str, cor, bg) {
  var val = num !== '' ? String(num) : str;
  return '<div style="background:' + bg + ';border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid ' + cor + '33;">' +
    '<div style="font-size:22px;margin-bottom:6px;">' + icon + '</div>' +
    '<div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:' + cor + ';">' + val + '</div>' +
    '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px;">' + label + '</div>' +
    '</div>';
}

function exportarDashCSV() {
  var orcs = getHistorico().map(function(h){ return {tipo:'Orçamento', nome:h.nome||'', marca:(h.marca||'gaideski')==='planicom'?'Planicom':'Gaideski', servico:h.servicos||'', valor:h.totalFmt||'', data:h.dataISO||''}; });
  var conts = getHistoricoContrato().map(function(h){ return {tipo:'Contrato', nome:h.nome||'', marca:(h.empresa||'gaideski')==='planicom'?'Planicom':'Gaideski', servico:h.regime||'', valor:h.remuneracao||'', data:h.data||''}; });
  var todos = orcs.concat(conts).sort(function(a,b){ return b.data.localeCompare(a.data); });
  var csv = 'Tipo,Cliente,Empresa,Serviço/Regime,Valor,Data\r\n';
  todos.forEach(function(r) {
    csv += [r.tipo, r.nome, r.marca, r.servico, r.valor, r.data].map(function(v){ return '"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"'; }).join(',') + '\r\n';
  });
  var blob = new Blob(['﻿'+csv], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url; a.download='Gaideski_Dashboard_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv';
  a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}



function abrirModalDash(idx) {
  var hist = getHistorico();
  var h = hist[idx];
  if (!h) return;
  _dashEditIdx = idx;
  document.getElementById('dash_edit_num').value = h.num || '';
  document.getElementById('dash_edit_nome').value = h.nome || '';
  document.getElementById('dash_edit_data').value = h.dataISO || '';
  document.getElementById('dash_edit_servicos').value = h.servicos || '';
  document.getElementById('dash_edit_total').value = h.totalFmt || '';
  document.getElementById('dash_edit_obs').value = h.obs || '';
  var selMarca = document.getElementById('dash_edit_marca');
  for (var i=0; i<selMarca.options.length; i++) {
    if (selMarca.options[i].value === (h.marca||'gaideski')) { selMarca.selectedIndex = i; break; }
  }
  var bg = document.getElementById('dash_modal_bg');
  bg.style.display = 'flex';
}

function fecharModalDash() {
  document.getElementById('dash_modal_bg').style.display = 'none';
  _dashEditIdx = -1;
}

function salvarEdicaoDash() {
  if (_dashEditIdx < 0) return;
  var hist = getHistorico();
  var h = hist[_dashEditIdx];
  if (!h) return;
  var novaDataISO = document.getElementById('dash_edit_data').value;
  h.num = document.getElementById('dash_edit_num').value.trim();
  h.nome = document.getElementById('dash_edit_nome').value.trim();
  h.dataISO = novaDataISO;
  h.data = novaDataISO ? formatarData(novaDataISO) : h.data;
  h.servicos = document.getElementById('dash_edit_servicos').value.trim();
  h.totalFmt = document.getElementById('dash_edit_total').value.trim();
  h.total = parseMoeda(h.totalFmt);
  h.obs = document.getElementById('dash_edit_obs').value.trim();
  h.marca = document.getElementById('dash_edit_marca').value;
  localStorage.setItem('gaideski_historico', JSON.stringify(hist));
  fecharModalDash();
  renderDashboard();
  mostrarMsg('✓ Orçamento atualizado!', 'success');
}

function excluirDash(idx) {
  var hist = getHistorico();
  var h = hist[idx];
  if (!h) return;
  if (!confirm('Excluir o orçamento de ' + (h.nome||'este cliente') + '?')) return;
  hist.splice(idx, 1);
  localStorage.setItem('gaideski_historico', JSON.stringify(hist));
  renderDashboard();
}

function mascaraMoedaInput(el) {
  var v = el.value.replace(/[^0-9,]/g,'');
  el.value = v;
}

function exportarCSV() {
  var hist = getHistorico();
  var busca = (document.getElementById('dash_busca').value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  var mesSel = document.getElementById('dash_mes').value;
  var anoSel = document.getElementById('dash_ano').value;
  var marcaSel = document.getElementById('dash_marca').value;
  var filtrado = hist.filter(function(h) {
    var matchBusca = !busca || (h.nome||'').toLowerCase().includes(busca);
    var matchAno = !anoSel || (h.dataISO||'').slice(0,4) === anoSel;
    var matchMes = !mesSel || (h.dataISO||'').slice(5,7) === mesSel;
    var matchMarca = !marcaSel || (h.marca||'gaideski') === marcaSel;
    return matchBusca && matchAno && matchMes && matchMarca;
  }).sort(function(a,b){ return (b.ts||0)-(a.ts||0); });

  var linhas = ['Nº;Data;Cliente;Empresa;Serviços;Total;Observação'];
  filtrado.forEach(function(h) {
    linhas.push([
      h.num||'', h.data||'', (h.nome||'').replace(/;/g,' '),
      h.marca==='planicom'?'Planicom':'Gaideski',
      (h.servicos||'').replace(/;/g,' '),
      h.totalFmt||'', (h.obs||'').replace(/;/g,' ')
    ].join(';'));
  });
  var blob = new Blob(['﻿'+linhas.join('\r\n')], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'Orcamentos_Gaideski_' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) + '.csv';
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

// ── Troca de abas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function trocarAba(aba) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.getElementById('pane-' + aba).classList.add('active');
  event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  if (aba === 'tabela') setTimeout(calcularHonorario, 100);
  if (aba === 'orcamento') setTimeout(function(){ selecionarMarcaOrc(_marcaOrc); }, 50);
  if (aba === 'dashboard') setTimeout(renderDashboard, 100);
}

// ── Máscaras ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function mascaraCNPJ(el) {
  var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,14);
  if (v.length > 12) v = v.slice(0,2)+'.'+v.slice(2,5)+'.'+v.slice(5,8)+'/'+v.slice(8,12)+'-'+v.slice(12);
  else if (v.length > 8) v = v.slice(0,2)+'.'+v.slice(2,5)+'.'+v.slice(5,8)+'/'+v.slice(8);
  else if (v.length > 5) v = v.slice(0,2)+'.'+v.slice(2,5)+'.'+v.slice(5);
  else if (v.length > 2) v = v.slice(0,2)+'.'+v.slice(2);
  el.value = v;
}
function mascaraCPF(el) {
  var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,11);
  if (v.length > 9) v = v.slice(0,3)+'.'+v.slice(3,6)+'.'+v.slice(6,9)+'-'+v.slice(9);
  else if (v.length > 6) v = v.slice(0,3)+'.'+v.slice(3,6)+'.'+v.slice(6);
  else if (v.length > 3) v = v.slice(0,3)+'.'+v.slice(3);
  el.value = v;
}

// ── Gerador de contrato ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const CONTRATO_B64 = "";
const PLANICON_B64 = "";
const PLANICON_LOGO_B64 = "";

async function gerarContrato() {
  var obrigatorios = [
    ['c_nome','Razão Social'],['c_cnpj','CNPJ'],['c_endereco','Endereço'],
    ['c_rep','Nome do representante'],['c_cpf','CPF'],
    ['c_objeto','Objeto / ramo de atividade'],['c_vigencia','Vigência'],
    ['c_remuneracao','Remuneração'],
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < obrigatorios.length; i++) {
    var el = document.getElementById(obrigatorios[i][0]);
    if (!el || !el.value.trim()) {
      mostrarMsgContrato('Preencha: ' + obrigatorios[i][1], 'error');
      if (el) el.focus();
      return;
    }
  }
  var btn = document.getElementById('btnGerarContrato');
  btn.classList.add('loading'); btn.disabled = true;
  try {
    var modeloB64 = (_empresaContrato === 'planicom') ? PLANICON_B64 : CONTRATO_B64;
    var zip = await loadZip(base64ToArrayBuffer(modeloB64));
    var xmlStr = await zip.file('word/document.xml').async('string');

    var nome  = document.getElementById('c_nome').value.trim().toUpperCase();
    var cnpj  = document.getElementById('c_cnpj').value.trim();
    var end_raw = document.getElementById('c_endereco').value;
    var end_  = end_raw.trim().toUpperCase();
    var rep   = document.getElementById('c_rep').value.trim().toUpperCase();
    var cpf   = document.getElementById('c_cpf').value.trim();
    var cargo = (document.getElementById('c_cargo').value.trim() || 'ADMINISTRADOR').toUpperCase();
    var obj   = document.getElementById('c_objeto').value.trim();
    var folha = document.getElementById('c_folha').value.trim();
    var vig   = document.getElementById('c_vigencia').value.trim();
    var reg   = document.getElementById('c_regime').value;
    var fat   = document.getElementById('c_faturamento').value.trim();
    var rem   = document.getElementById('c_remuneracao').value.trim();
    var venc  = document.getElementById('c_vencimento').value.trim();

    function ex(s) {
      return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
    }

    // Substituir todos os placeholders ##XX## diretamente
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##NOME##').join(ex(nome));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##CNPJ##').join(ex(cnpj));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##ENDERECO##').join(ex(end_));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##REP##').join(ex(rep));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##CPF##').join(ex(cpf));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##CARGO##').join(ex(cargo));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##OBJETO##').join(ex(obj));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##FOLHA##').join(ex(folha));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##VIGENCIA##').join(ex(vig));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##REGIME##').join(ex(reg));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##FATURAMENTO##').join(ex(fat));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##REMUNERACAO##').join(ex(rem));
    xmlStr = xmlStr.split('##VENCIMENTO##').join(ex(venc));

    zip.file('word/document.xml', xmlStr);
    var blob = await zip.generateAsync({type:'blob',mimeType:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'});
    var ts = new Date(); var tsStr = ts.getFullYear()+''+String(ts.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+''+String(ts.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
    var empresaNome = (_empresaContrato === 'planicom') ? 'Planicom' : 'Gaideski';
    var filename = 'Contrato_' + empresaNome + '_' + nome.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,'_').slice(0,25) + '_' + tsStr;
    if (_formato.contrato === 'pdf') {
      await docxToPdfAndDownload(blob, filename + '.pdf');
    } else {
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url; a.download = filename + '.docx';
      a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }

    // Salvar no histórico de contratos
    salvarNoHistoricoContrato({
      nome: document.getElementById('c_nome').value.trim(),
      empresa: _empresaContrato,
      cnpj: cnpj, rep: rep, cargo: cargo,
      endereco: document.getElementById('c_endereco').value.trim(),
      cpf: cpf, objeto: obj, folha: folha,
      vigencia: vig, regime: reg,
      faturamento: fat, remuneracao: rem, vencimento: venc,
      data: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), ts: Date.now()
    });

    mostrarMsgContrato('✓ Contrato gerado com sucesso!', 'success');
    setTimeout(function() {
      ['c_nome','c_cnpj','c_endereco','c_rep','c_cpf','c_objeto','c_faturamento','c_remuneracao','c_vigencia'].forEach(function(id){
        var el = document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.value='';
      });
      document.getElementById('c_folha').value='Sem folha';
      document.getElementById('c_vencimento').value='05';
      document.getElementById('c_cargo').value='ADMINISTRADOR';
      renderHistoricoContrato();
    }, 1500);
  } catch(e) {
    console.error(e);
    mostrarMsgContrato('Erro: ' + e.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.classList.remove('loading'); btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

// ── JSZip embutido via CDN com fallback ────────────────────────────────
var _zipLib = null;
async function loadZip(buffer) {
  if (!_zipLib) {
    // Tentar carregar JSZip do CDN
    await new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js';
      s.onload = resolve;
      s.onerror = reject;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    _zipLib = JSZip;
  }
  return await _zipLib.loadAsync(buffer);
}

// ── Numeração automática ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getProximoNumero() {
  const ultimo = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('gaideski_ultimo_num') || '0');
  return ultimo + 1;
}
function gerarNumeroAuto() {
  const n = getProximoNumero();
  return 'OR-' + String(n).padStart(3, '0');
}
function salvarNumeroUsado(num) {
  const match = num.match(/(\d+)$/);
  if (match) localStorage.setItem('gaideski_ultimo_num', match[1]);
}
function editarNumero() {
  const input = document.getElementById('numOrcamento');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnEditNum');
  if (input.readOnly) {
    input.readOnly = false;
    input.focus();
    input.select();
    btn.textContent = '✓ Ok';
    btn.style.borderColor = '#1A1A1A';
    btn.style.color = '#1A1A1A';
  } else {
    input.readOnly = true;
    btn.textContent = '✎ Editar';
    btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--border)';
    btn.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
  }
}

function confirmarItemLivre(id) {
  var card = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!card) return;
  var desc = card.querySelector('.item-desc').value.trim();
  if (!desc) { card.querySelector('.item-desc').focus(); card.querySelector('.item-desc').style.borderColor='#C0392B'; return; }
  var val = parseMoeda(card.querySelector('.item-val').value);
  if (val <= 0) { card.querySelector('.item-val').focus(); card.querySelector('.item-val').style.borderColor='#C0392B'; return; }

  var detalhe = card.querySelector('.item-detalhe').value.trim();
  var chk = card.querySelector('.item-chk-desc');
  var pct = parseFloat(card.querySelector('.item-pct-desc').value) || 0;
  var temDesc = chk && chk.checked && pct > 0;
  var valFinal = temDesc ? val - (val * pct / 100) : val;

  // Montar resumo visual do item confirmado
  var resumoDesc = desc + (detalhe ? ' — ' + detalhe : '');
  var resumoVal = temDesc
    ? '<span style="text-decoration:line-through;color:#AAAAAA;font-size:12px;">' + formatMoeda(val) + '</span> <strong>' + formatMoeda(valFinal) + '</strong>'
    : '<strong>' + formatMoeda(valFinal) + '</strong>';
  if (temDesc) resumoDesc += ' <span style="background:#F0F0F0;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:11px;color:#555;">-' + pct + '%</span>';

  card.innerHTML =
    '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;">' +
      '<div style="font-size:14px;color:#1A1A1A;flex:1;">' + resumoDesc + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:14px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;">' + resumoVal + '</div>' +
      '<button onclick="editarItemLivre(\'' + id + '\')" style="height:28px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;color:#888880;flex-shrink:0;" title="Editar">✎ Editar</button>' +
      '<button onclick="removerItemLivre(\'' + id + '\')" style="width:28px;height:28px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;color:#888880;flex-shrink:0;" title="Remover">&times;</button>' +
    '</div>';

  // Guardar dados no dataset para leitura posterior
  card.dataset.desc = desc;
  card.dataset.detalhe = detalhe;
  card.dataset.val = val;
  card.dataset.valFinal = valFinal;
  card.dataset.pct = temDesc ? pct : 0;
  card.dataset.temDesc = temDesc ? '1' : '0';
  card.dataset.confirmado = '1';

  atualizarResumo();
  // Scroll suave para o botão adicionar
  document.getElementById('btnAddItem').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
}

function editarItemLivre(id) {

  card.innerHTML = '';

  var inDesc = document.createElement('input'); inDesc.type='text'; inDesc.placeholder='Descrição do serviço *'; inDesc.className='item-desc'; inDesc.value=desc;
  inDesc.style.cssText='height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:14px;background:#fff;outline:none;width:100%;';
  inDesc.addEventListener('input', atualizarResumo);
  var inDet = document.createElement('input'); inDet.type='text'; inDet.placeholder='Detalhe / observação (opcional)'; inDet.className='item-detalhe'; inDet.value=detalhe;
  inDet.style.cssText='height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:14px;background:#fff;outline:none;width:100%;';
  inDet.addEventListener('input', atualizarResumo);
  row1.appendChild(inDesc); row1.appendChild(inDet);

  var row2 = document.createElement('div'); row2.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;';
  var lblVal = document.createElement('span'); lblVal.textContent='Valor:'; lblVal.style.cssText='font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#888880;white-space:nowrap;';
  var inVal = document.createElement('input'); inVal.type='text'; inVal.placeholder='R$ 0,00'; inVal.className='item-val'; inVal.value=formatMoeda(val);
  inVal.style.cssText='width:120px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;text-align:right;background:#fff;outline:none;';
  inVal.addEventListener('input', function(){ atualizarDescItemLivre(id); atualizarResumo(); });
  var sep = document.createElement('div'); sep.style.cssText='width:1px;height:24px;background:#E2E0DA;margin:0 4px;';
  var lblDesc2 = document.createElement('label'); lblDesc2.style.cssText='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#888880;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;';
  var chkDesc2 = document.createElement('input'); chkDesc2.type='checkbox'; chkDesc2.className='item-chk-desc'; chkDesc2.checked=temDesc;
  chkDesc2.style.cssText='width:15px;height:15px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:#1A1A1A;';
  chkDesc2.addEventListener('change', function(){ atualizarDescItemLivre(id); atualizarResumo(); });
  lblDesc2.appendChild(chkDesc2); lblDesc2.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Desconto'));
  var inPct2 = document.createElement('input'); inPct2.type='number'; inPct2.min='1'; inPct2.max='99'; inPct2.value=pct; inPct2.className='item-pct-desc';
  inPct2.style.cssText='width:52px;height:32px;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:6px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;text-align:center;background:#fff;outline:none;display:'+(temDesc?'block':'none')+';';
  inPct2.addEventListener('input', function(){ atualizarDescItemLivre(id); atualizarResumo(); });
  var lblPct2 = document.createElement('span'); lblPct2.textContent='%'; lblPct2.className='item-lbl-pct';
  lblPct2.style.cssText='font-size:12px;color:#888880;display:'+(temDesc?'inline':'none')+';';
  var spanFinal2 = document.createElement('span'); spanFinal2.className='item-val-final';
  spanFinal2.style.cssText='font-size:12px;color:#1A1A1A;font-weight:600;display:none;margin-left:4px;';
  var spacer2 = document.createElement('div'); spacer2.style.cssText='flex:1;';
  var btnRem2 = document.createElement('button'); btnRem2.title='Remover'; btnRem2.innerHTML='&times;';
  btnRem2.style.cssText='width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid #E2E0DA;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;color:#888880;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;';
  btnRem2.addEventListener('click', function(){ removerItemLivre(id); });
  row2.appendChild(lblVal); row2.appendChild(inVal); row2.appendChild(sep); row2.appendChild(lblDesc2); row2.appendChild(inPct2); row2.appendChild(lblPct2); row2.appendChild(spanFinal2); row2.appendChild(spacer2); row2.appendChild(btnRem2);

  var row3 = document.createElement('div'); row3.style.cssText='display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding-top:4px;';
  var btnOk2 = document.createElement('button'); btnOk2.textContent='✓ Confirmar item';
  btnOk2.style.cssText='height:36px;padding:0 18px;background:#1A1A1A;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;';
  btnOk2.addEventListener('click', function(){ confirmarItemLivre(id); });
  row3.appendChild(btnOk2);

  card.appendChild(row1); card.appendChild(row2); card.appendChild(row3);
  if (temDesc) atualizarDescItemLivre(id);
  inDesc.focus();
}

function atualizarDescItemLivre(id) {
  var card = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!card) return;
  var chk = card.querySelector('.item-chk-desc');
  var inPct = card.querySelector('.item-pct-desc');
  var lblPct = card.querySelector('.item-lbl-pct');
  var inVal = card.querySelector('.item-val');
  var spanFinal = card.querySelector('.item-val-final');

  if (chk.checked) {
    inPct.style.display = 'block';
    lblPct.style.display = 'inline';
    var val = parseMoeda(inVal.value);
    var pct = parseFloat(inPct.value) || 0;
    var final = val - (val * pct / 100);
    spanFinal.style.display = 'inline';
    spanFinal.textContent = '= ' + formatMoeda(final);
  } else {
    inPct.style.display = 'none';
    lblPct.style.display = 'none';
    spanFinal.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function removerItemLivre(id) {
  var el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) { el.remove(); atualizarResumo(); }
}

function getItensLivres() {
  return Array.from(document.getElementById('itensLivreContainer').children).map(function(card) {
    if (card.dataset.confirmado === '1') {
      var val = parseFloat(card.dataset.val) || 0;
      var valFinal = parseFloat(card.dataset.valFinal) || val;
      var pct = parseFloat(card.dataset.pct) || 0;
      var temDesc = card.dataset.temDesc === '1';
      return { desc: card.dataset.desc, detalhe: card.dataset.detalhe, val: val, valFinal: valFinal, pct: pct, temDesc: temDesc, descLabel: temDesc ? 'Desconto ' + pct + '%' : '' };
    }
    // Item ainda em edição
    var desc = card.querySelector('.item-desc') ? card.querySelector('.item-desc').value.trim() : '';
    var detalhe = card.querySelector('.item-detalhe') ? card.querySelector('.item-detalhe').value.trim() : '';
    var val = card.querySelector('.item-val') ? parseMoeda(card.querySelector('.item-val').value) : 0;
    var chk = card.querySelector('.item-chk-desc');
    var pct = card.querySelector('.item-pct-desc') ? parseFloat(card.querySelector('.item-pct-desc').value) || 0 : 0;
    var temDesc = chk && chk.checked && pct > 0;
    var valFinal = temDesc ? val - (val * pct / 100) : val;
    return { desc: desc, detalhe: detalhe, val: val, valFinal: valFinal, pct: pct, temDesc: temDesc, descLabel: temDesc ? 'Desconto ' + pct + '%' : '' };
  });
}
</script>

<!-- ── Modal edição Dashboard ─────────────────────────────── -->
<div id="dash_modal_bg" onclick="var bg=document.getElementById('dash_modal_bg');if(bg&&event.target===bg)fecharModalDash();"
  style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55);z-index:9999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">
  <div style="background:var(--surface);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 28px 24px;width:92%;max-width:500px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;">

    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:22px;">
      <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);">✏️ Editar Orçamento</h3>
      <button onclick="fecharModalDash()" style="background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1;">×</button>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;">

      <div>
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Nº Orçamento</label>
        <input id="dash_edit_num" type="text"
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
      </div>

      <div>
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Data</label>
        <input id="dash_edit_data" type="date"
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
      </div>

      <div style="grid-column:span 2;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Cliente</label>
        <input id="dash_edit_nome" type="text"
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
      </div>

      <div style="grid-column:span 2;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Serviços</label>
        <input id="dash_edit_servicos" type="text"
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
      </div>

      <div>
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Valor Total</label>
        <input id="dash_edit_total" type="text" placeholder="R$ 0,00"
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
      </div>

      <div>
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Marca</label>
        <select id="dash_edit_marca"
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
          <option value="gaideski">🔵 Gaideski</option>
          <option value="planicom">🟢 Planicom</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div style="grid-column:span 2;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--text-muted);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Observação (opcional)</label>
        <input id="dash_edit_obs" type="text" placeholder="Ex: Cliente solicitou proposta urgente..."
          style="width:100%;height:38px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;">
      </div>

    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:22px;">
      <button onclick="fecharModalDash()"
        style="height:40px;padding:0 20px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:transparent;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text);">
        Cancelar
      </button>
      <button onclick="salvarEdicaoDash()"
        style="height:40px;padding:0 22px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:#1A1A1A;color:#fff;font-family:DM Sans,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">
        ✓ Salvar alterações
      </button>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

</body>
</html>
